limits: No current campaign completion, numeric result, uncertainty result, literature agreement or bead-control pass is asserted by this review.

The policy allows a separate 12-hour metadata-only waiting phase; its 600-second budget applies after completion admission. The work timer fires with 10 seconds reserved for bounded owned-process drain and finalization. OS scheduling, timer and filesystem failure granularity remain ordinary operational limits.

Handled SIGINT/SIGTERM are deferred through cleanup. An uncatchable waiter kill cannot promise a final receipt; the independent child alarm and permanent attempt claim prevent unbounded analyzer continuation or silent retry.
The dedicated Linux wrapper/child process and frozen single-thread environment are part of the reviewed execution contract.
A scientific-control false result is still a valid complete analysis outcome and is retained; the wrapper never launches another calculation to improve it.

resolved_findings.finding: The initial 600-second deadline was cooperative and the prelaunch whole-input hash loop had no internal budget checkpoint. A slow verification could overrun, and a forcibly killed waiter did not impose a separate analyzer timer.
resolved_findings.resolution: Final source checks time/stop per file and per 1 MiB hash block, installs a work alarm at the 590-second work deadline, installs a default-SIGALRM child timer before exec, defers the wrapper alarm across Popen/reference capture, and reconfirms owned-child drain after the work alarm context disarms. Five added inert fixtures cover these paths; prior candidate and 38-case gate remain preserved.

review_method: Read-only source, policy, fixture and preserved gate inspection. No new test execution by reviewer.
reviewer: distribution agent; independent of wrapper author
scope: Future admission only after complete root launch receipt, exact root-observed exec session 30588 normal exit, released child lease and fixed complete global cohort.
Exact eight seeds, two timesteps, two pair batches, 32 branch report/settings identities, 800 distinct raw chunk paths and 76800000 native steps.
Full source/runtime/model/parent/baseline identities, successful one-start/one-reap worker journal, and all final input hashes before and after unchanged analyzer execution.
Permanent execution-directory/RUN_ONCE claim including failure; no replacement output, automatic retry, resume, extension, partial-data analyzer or alternate scientific estimator.
Owned analyzer process group, signal deferral, post-Popen journal failure cleanup, exact invocation count even on failure, and retained unconfirmed-drain state.
Independent child kernel wall alarm, chunked hash budget checks, post-ready work alarm and reserved final drain.

trust_boundary.adoption: The approved_for_complete_analysis_once field is an implementation-review decision only. A separate exact root adoption and all future completion predicates are still mandatory.
trust_boundary.root_actual_exit_attestation: The root-created receipt explicitly attests actual session 30588, normal tool exit and all workers drained. It hash-binds the original saved tool-observation bytes. This wrapper verifies that attestation and the bytes but does not independently interpret an arbitrary tool-response schema or contact the execution service.
trust_boundary.worker_scientific_completeness: The frozen child coordinator and unchanged analyzer are the scientific/raw-array validators. This wrapper additionally checks exact complete membership, receipt consistency and all file identities. This review does not itself inspect active raw arrays.
